name: Shop — Aditya Singh
summary: Shop page selling hand-assembled hardware: a 64x64 RGB LED album-art display, a magnetic phone mirror, and a free Mac screensaver app.
description: Aditya Singh's shop for small-batch hardware assembled by hand in India: VYNL (₹9,999, a 64x64 RGB LED matrix that shows now-playing album art with spinning CD and album-art modes), MYRRA (₹599, a mini convex mirror that snaps onto a phone's magnetic back) and PinWall (free Mac app that turns a Pinterest feed or iCloud album into a slow living wall on the idle screen). Includes a limited-drop email signup, a cart and a returns page.
